'''2008 Ralltiir Regionals''' was the German ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship of 2008, played in Hannover, Germany, on Saturday 10 May 2008.<ref name="sf-19214-299380">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=299380#p299380 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Philipp, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-19214-301014">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=301014#p301014 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Uber-Obi, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (11 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref> It had 21 participants. The winner, posted as "Angelo", was [[Angelo Consoli]], who posted on the forum as Gravityshadow and wrote a tournament report on the event.<ref name="sf-19214-301014" /><ref name="sf-19214-307254">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=307254#p307254 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Gravityshadow (Angelo Consoli), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (13 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Hannover, Germany<ref name="sf-19214-269148">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=269148#p269148 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Uber-Obi, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 February 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 10 May 2008; first listed for Sunday 11 May, then moved to the 10th by the organizer, Chris, by e-mail<ref name="sf-19214-269148" /><ref name="sf-19214-269536">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=269536#p269536 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Uber-Obi, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 February 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-19214-299380" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Angelo Consoli]]<ref name="sf-19214-301014" />

== Results ==

Uber-Obi posted the result the next day. He gave places two to seven "if I remember correctly", and wrote that the European and match-play champion [[Nico Kreidl]] had a bad day and placed somewhere in the middle.<ref name="sf-19214-301014" />

! Place !! Player !! Decks
|-
| 1 || [[Angelo Consoli]] (posted as "Angelo") || Profit and BHBM
|-
| 2 || Jonas Skali || WYS and a Dark Side alien deck
|-
| 3 || [[Mario Boley]] || WHAP as Light Side
|-
| 4 || [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] || Hunt Down with docking bays and Hidden Mains
|-
| 5 || [[Chris Menzel]] || HD and a Lars Moisture Farm vaporator deck
|-
| 6 || [[Julian Fuss]] ||
|-
| 7 || [[Dirk Friedrichs]] ||

The decks of the top five, except Vanderhaegen's, are from a post by Roken, who marked Consoli's decks "iirc" and wrote that Boley "hunted down the Jedi" with his Dark Side deck; Roken gave Menzel by his forum name, Euremperor.<ref name="sf-19214-301099">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=301099#p301099 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Roken, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (11 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-15832-216444">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=216444#p216444 &#91;EUROPE&#93;: Champions' MPC on 17th and 18th November], Shadow 14 (Chris Menzel), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 July 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125033315/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=15832 Internet Archive]</ref> Vanderhaegen gave his own decks.<ref name="sf-19214-301685">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=301685#p301685 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Calaglin (Cedrik Vanderhaegen), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Consoli and Menzel submitted tournament reports on DeckTech; Menzel's was listed as the fifth-place report from the Germany regionals.<ref name="sf-19214-307254" /><ref name="sf-21635-311852">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311852#p311852 tournament reports, etc], Throdo (Jonathan Murray), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (2 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192041/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21635.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Ralltiir Cup ==

The trophy of the German regional championship, the Ralltiir Cup, broke in 2007. Uber-Obi had it repaired before the 2008 event and updated the engraved names of the past winners:<ref name="sf-19214-299372">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=299372#p299372 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Uber-Obi, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref>
